metadata.quality:
实验近似 / Experimental approximation. 实拍还原度未验证 / photographic fidelity NOT validated.
A: 官方感度图；一代官方特性曲线。
B: 二代使用 JCH 候选特性曲线，其图下注为 Phoenix I，代际归属尚未核实。
C: 感度刻度解释、曝光标定、Gold 染料代理、紫色底基、合成密度计、颗粒与光晕均含假设。
metadata.license: Derivative of spektrafilm Kodak Gold 200 profile by Andrea Volpato, CC BY-SA 4.0. Changes: Phoenix chart-derived sensitivity/response, estimated unmasked base and effects. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ ; see PHOENIX_EXPERIMENTAL_NOTICE.md
metadata.datasource: HARMAN charts digitized offline; Gold 200 dye proxy from spektrafilm (https://github.com/andreavolpato/spektrafilm). II characteristic uses provisional JCH screenshot; caption says Phoenix I, generation unverified. Gaussian synthetic densitometer, NOT Status M. Unmeasured purple base, exposure anchor, grain and halation. Evidence A/B/C in evidence.

evidence.A: Manufacturer chart/explicit product statement; digitization retains original interpretation limits
evidence.B: Secondary published chart; provenance/generation not fully verified
evidence.C: Explicit mathematical proxy, parameter estimate or borrowed other-stock measurement
evidence.spectral: A chart; C ordinate interpretation and channel normalization
evidence.characteristic_200: A chart; C unresolved shadow completion and exposure anchor
evidence.characteristic_ii: B JCH candidate with Phoenix I caption conflict; provisional II assignment is an explicit hypothesis
evidence.dyes: C Gold 200 proxy, not measured Phoenix dyes; missing tails neutralized by assumption
evidence.base: C unmasked purple base model, no measured base spectrum
evidence.densitometry: C synthetic Gaussian instrument, NOT Status M; closure only to this assumed instrument
evidence.grain_halation: C engine-model estimates; II finer grain qualitative ordering follows manufacturer, numbers unmeasured
evidence.dir_couplers: C material baseline 0.15 of generic negative-film coupling. Full generic coupling folds the transformed exposure axis for this high-contrast reconstruction; reduced estimated coupling preserves monotonic development, not measured HARMAN chemistry.
